mandatory_snapshot_and_TOCTOU_laws: The sole caller path is --live-bindings and is opened before any nested path, live metadata path, numerical import, or caller-supplied release/capability path.
Validate the complete non-null canonical root inventory before constructing any nested path from the envelope.
Traverse each directory component with held dirfds and O_NOFOLLOW; lstat-then-open by absolute pathname is insufficient.
Open every envelope, release, Runtime GO, anchor, anchor review, capability, and other control document once as a regular one-link file; hash and strict-decode those exact held-FD bytes.
Keep the snapshot FDs open through graph validation and authority consumption; do not close and later reopen a pathname to revalidate it.
Require canonical strict JSON with duplicate-key and nonfinite-token rejection, exact field sets, exact native scalar types, and bounded control-document size.
Derive executed runner, launcher, helper, contract, numerical-body, and package identities from authenticated loaded or staged bytes; never accept actual self hashes from CLI or bindings.
Cross-check every root in core, release, and envelope against the same parsed byte snapshot before any caller-path access.

Use a fresh staged directory, exclusive creation, fsync, read-only one-link files, and atomic publication for each issuance phase; bind the immutable phase-one anchor into the external review and terminal phase.
Enforce five-minute chronology, distinct issuer/reviewer identities, one-use capability, CPU-only, one-run, no-retry, and authority-directory colocation before caller-path access.
